command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$projects=@('CampusNetwork-for-perf','CampusNetwork-for-perf_02','CampusNetwork-for-perf_04','CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09'); foreach(`$p in `$projects){ '===== '+`$p+' ====='; foreach(`$n in @('PE1','PE2','PE3')){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString('display current-configuration'); `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output; `$m=`$o -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -match '^(ip route-static 150|ip route-static 160|static-lsp)' }; if(`$m){ `$n+': '+(`$m -join ' | ') } } }"
